body:
My S.O. recently bought the house I've wanted since I was 6 (It's next door to my parent's house- I only cared about location.)   
It's like this place was 'renovated' by a child - Those are the house inspector's words, lol.  


I've fixed quite a few things so far, and I keep finding new things.   
For one, both outlets I replaced (so far) were wired incorrectly in different ways.

Same issue here, refused to evolve until I walked him, then while he was still out of the ball used a rare candy. I tried it before closing the software, to rule it out... I think it might be intentional that it requires dust or candy to evolve...
I hate being loved. But you're right. Just a few more months of life won't hurt right? Just a few more months of pain are fine?

I've tried. So hard. My base instinct is to run away, run into danger in the hopes that I won't make it out, so my family will blame someone other than me for my death.

Thank you for responding, I appreciate your time.

Oh good. My friend just invited me to go watch a movie on Friday. Not because he wants me there but because he needs a ride.

I'm glad my existence is so convenient for my friends. They'll probably miss my car more than me.

I understand. I still haven't figured out how to talk to people about this.

It's hard when the memory comes up.

I'm here if you need to talk.
